# Timetable {#sec-timetable .unnumbered}

The course is made of 13 sessions. Each session comprises 5 (teaching) units of 45 minutes. Following feedback from earlier years, each session spans over the lunch break. The preferred timing for each session is

**Monday 10:15 to 11:45 ; lunch break; 13:15 to 15:30**

Lunch break time may however vary a little based on contents and progress. We have attempted to balance theoretical explanations and R practice within each session.

The 2025-2026 schedule is set as follows. Please refer to your *student guichet* and your emails (potentially sent through *Moodle*) for potential changes during the semester.

- 22 Sept
- 29 Sept
- 06 Oct
- 13 Oct
- 20 Oct
- 27 Oct

- 08 Dec
- *15 Dec (Not scheduled but please reserve for Q&A)*
- *We also like to organize a mock R exam during the January exams' preparation session*
